title: A vacant St. John lot, 2013 to 2028
subtitle: How a city-owned block at 800 E. St. John Ave. reached a groundbreaking
alt: Timeline of the St. John redevelopment site at 800 East St. John Avenue in Austin: the city bought the land in 2013 and it sat empty for nearly 20 years; in 2017 the City Council directed staff to plan the site with neighbors; earlier in 2026 the city signed a redevelopment deal with the Housing Authority of the City of Austin and Greystar for 526 rental apartments, commercial space and an expanded park; on September 14, 2026 Airbnb put in 6.4 million dollars toward the 201 fully affordable apartments; crews are now clearing the site and final delivery is anticipated in 2028
source: KXAN and CBS Austin, from the city and Airbnb
